name: evolvix
description: Skills that let Claude do the weekly coaching work in Evolvix: check-in reviews, nutrition by training day, programs, and logging for clients.

plugins.name: evolvix-coach
plugins.description: For coaches: run the day and the inbox, review clients, calls and check-ins, plan training and nutrition by training day, add clients with their history, and build check-in forms and automations through the Evolvix connector.

plugins.name: evolvix-client
plugins.description: For clients of an Evolvix coach: log food, training and weight from a sentence, see today's plan, and do your check-in.
